verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Holy design, this place in time
That I might seek and find my God
My God

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Lord, I want to yearn for You
I want to burn with passion over You
And only You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Your joy is mine
Yet why am I fine
With all my singing and bringing grain
In light of Him

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Oh You give life and breath
In You we live and move
That’s why I sing

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Be near, oh God
Be near, oh God of us
Your nearness is to us our good
